# J BOWMAN → Webflow

Generated by `dist/tools/webflow-export.py`. Re-run it after any change to
the static site and these files regenerate.

```
webflow/
  paste/home.json        Paste payloads, one per page.
  paste/about.json
  paste/work.json
  paste/services.json
  paste/journal.json
  paste/connect.json
  custom-code-head.html  → Project Settings → Custom Code → Head
  custom-code-footer.html → Project Settings → Custom Code → Footer
```

## How the paste works

Webflow's Designer accepts its own clipboard format. Each `.json` file here
is one page's worth of real Webflow elements and styles.

1. Open the page in the Webflow Designer.
2. Open the `.json` file in a text editor, select all, copy.
3. Click once on the Webflow canvas, then press **Cmd-V** / **Ctrl-V**.

The elements appear with the site's class names, and the brand styles —
type scale, colours, band padding — land as editable Webflow styles.

**Do Home first and check it before pasting the rest.** If Home pastes
correctly, the other five will too.

## Order of operations

1. **Fonts** — Project Settings → Fonts → Google Fonts. Add **Belleza 400
   only** and **Montserrat 300, 400, 500, 300 italic, 400 italic**. Nothing
   else. Do this before pasting, or the first paste renders in a fallback.
2. **Custom code** — paste `custom-code-head.html` into Head and
   `custom-code-footer.html` into Footer, then publish once. These carry the
   149 rules Webflow's style panel cannot express.
3. **Paste Home**, check it, then the other five pages.
4. **Upload the images** from `assets/img/` (the `.jpg` and `.png` files;
   skip the `.webp` copies — Webflow makes its own). Each pasted image
   renders as a placeholder until you point it at the uploaded asset.
5. **Drop in the four native components** — see below.
6. **Build the two CMS collections** — Releases and Journal.

## What is deliberately not in the paste

Four things, each replaced by a placeholder Block carrying a
`data-placeholder` note so you can see exactly where it goes:

| Placeholder | What to drop in |
| --- | --- |
| Primary nav | Webflow's **Navbar** component. Transparent over the hero, Ink background once scrolled, collapses below 767px. |
| Contact form | Webflow's **Form Block**, so it actually submits. |
| Showreel | Webflow's **Video** element. Poster `reel-poster.jpg`, controls on, `preload="metadata"`, **no autoplay**. |
| Releases list | A **Collection List** bound to the Releases collection. |

A pasted imitation of any of these would look right and not work. The
footer's link row *is* exported, because it is only links.

## Two things to check after pasting

- **The copyright year is a literal `2026`.** The static site sets it from
  the clock. In Webflow either accept the literal and edit it annually, or
  add `<script>document.querySelectorAll('[data-year]').forEach(function(e){e.textContent=new Date().getFullYear()})</script>`
  to the footer code and give that span a `data-year` attribute.
- **Belleza must read 400 everywhere.** It ships one weight; heading tags
  default to bold, and the browser will fake it. The custom-code head block
  forces 400 on the display classes, but check any new element you add.

## The one place this conversion is not exact

The static site has a media query at `max-width: 60rem`, which is 960px.
Webflow's nearest breakpoint is `medium`, max-width 991px. Those rules are
therefore applied from 991px down instead of 960px down — a 31px window
where a handful of layout rules arrive slightly early. It affects spacing,
not content, and is invisible unless you are looking for it. To make it
exact, move those rules out of the `medium` variant and into the head
custom code under their original query.

## Honest status of the clipboard format

Webflow's clipboard payload is not a documented, versioned API. It is
stable in practice and widely used, but Webflow can change it without
notice. **This payload has not been tested against a live Webflow project**,
because the session that generated it had no network access to webflow.com.

If a paste does nothing at all, that is the format having moved, and
nothing is broken — fall back to building from the build sheet by hand. The
structure, styles and copy in these files are correct regardless; only the
transport is uncertain.
